usedFor: Stripe holds the payments, and ZenRows reads a web page through “Scraping a URL” after “When a payment succeeds”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a payment succeeds” in Stripe, then “Scraping a URL” in ZenRows
bestTemplate.why: A succeeded payment is a clear event, and the action extracts the HTML of a URL.

watchOut: “Scraping a URL with Autoparse” returns JSON for most popular websites only, so use “Scraping a URL” otherwise.
